name: Azeroth Companion
title: UNIFIED REAL MAPS — Legacy Map Retirement & Feature Migration
approval_note: Requested replacement of redundant older Atlas maps while retaining their existing saved behavior. External map availability and actual-player acceptance remain unverified.
features: Real game-derived maps remain the sole primary visual map viewer; schematic charts and stale illustrative lens are retired from view.
All 25 older Atlas destination identifiers remain usable for missions and saved route plans, with searchable destination lookup and supported-zone deep links.
Previous v16 missions, v18.1 routes, v22 waypoints, bookmarks and local records are never migrated destructively or deleted.
Advanced coordinate notebook remains accessible under one expandable panel; pins saved here refresh in the real map on the same page.
Unsupported historic zones use an external map directory instead of falsely displaying a different zone's map.
